title: Later Muscle Loss Can Reach 18% Per Decade
hook: Muscle loss accelerates, reaching 18% per decade later in life.
closing: Strength training matters more as muscle decline accelerates with age.
question: How often do you strength train?

segments.say: Muscle mass can fall to 65 percent of its starting level. Everyday strength becomes harder to preserve.
Later muscle loss reaches 18 percent per decade. Waiting to build strength becomes more costly.
Measured sarcopenia fell to zero after resistance training. Decline was not automatically irreversible.
